headline: AURA ENERGY TIRIS BFS COMPLETE — $500M NPV, $32.53/LB COST, DEC 2026 FID IN SIGHT FOR MAURITANIA URANIUM
snippet: Aura Energy (ASX: AEE) released its Tiris uranium bankable feasibility study on October 16, confirming a post-tax NPV of US$500.3 million, a 28% IRR, and a C1 cash cost of US$32.53/lb against the current long-term contract price of US$96.50/lb. Development capital is US$349.8 million with a 3.2-year payback and a 26-year mine life; a final investment decision is targeted for December 2026 following an 80-tonne pilot plant run in November-December, with first production aimed for end-2028.

headline: CENTINELA HUNGER STRIKE HITS DAY 8 — UNIONS WARN 50% COPPER OUTPUT CUT BY NOVEMBER AS TALKS STALL
snippet: Three workers at Antofagasta's Centinela copper mine in Chile entered their eighth day of hunger strike on October 16 after negotiations showed no progress despite regional government mediation. The two striking unions — representing over 700 workers — rejected the company's offer of a 2% wage increase and a $23,000 bonus, and warn that ongoing blockades could cut Centinela's copper production by up to 50% by November, a material supply-disruption risk in a market already sensitive to Chilean output pressures.

headline: $4,200 BACK IN SIGHT FOR GOLD AS FED WARSH STAYS SILENT ON RATE PATH
snippet: Gold climbed back toward $4,180 in early Friday trading after Fed Chair Warsh's scheduled speech passed without any hawkish rate commentary, effectively removing an October rate hike from the table and reviving near-term upside targets. The 20-day moving average at $4,192 is the key resistance to watch; a clean break would shift focus to $4,250, with support now established near $4,110 after the post-CPI selloff that pushed gold briefly to $4,086 earlier this week.

headline: ANTOFAGASTA Q3 COPPER UP 7% TO 151,900 TONNES — FULL-YEAR GUIDANCE HELD, COST OUTLOOK RAISED
snippet: Antofagasta reported Q3 2026 copper production of 151,900 tonnes on October 15, up 7% quarter-on-quarter, driven by Los Pelambres even as Centinela Concentrates fell 5% on lower grades. Year-to-date output of 436,900 tonnes remains 8% below 2025, and the company raised its cash cost forecast to $2.60–$2.70/lb while reaffirming full-year guidance of 625,000–655,000 tonnes — figures compiled before the mid-October Centinela strike began.

headline: PAN GLOBAL DRILLS 7.29 G/T Au OVER 9M AND 1.53 G/T OVER 38M — CÁRMENES GOLD DISCOVERY GROWS, SPAIN
snippet: Pan Global Resources (TSX-V: PGZ) released October 14 results from holes PVD17 and PVD18 at the Providencia target in northern Spain's Cármenes Project — 7.29 g/t gold over 9.0 metres and 1.53 g/t over 38.0 metres — extending a near-surface high-grade discovery now spanning 19 Phase 3 holes including earlier hits of 15m at 3.90 g/t and 83m at 1.74 g/t. The consistent grades across hole widths and orientations are building a contiguous near-surface gold zone in a European jurisdiction with established infrastructure and straightforward permitting precedent.

headline: SAFI SILVER CONFIRMS ADDANA SYSTEM SCALE, MOROCCO — 657 G/T Ag INTERCEPT PENDING RE-ASSAY VERIFICATION
snippet: Safi Silver (TSX-V: SF) reported first assays from its inaugural Addana drill program on October 14, including a confirmed 35.52 g/t Ag over 1.0 metre at depth and an unverified 657 g/t Ag intercept from a fault zone sample currently being re-assayed. Management argues that finding silver-bearing quartz-iron oxide veins at a secondary target 40 km from the core of the expected system demonstrates broader district-scale potential; results from the primary Antenna Hill target and six additional holes remain pending.

headline: HARANGA HITS 32M AT 10.4 G/T Au UNDERGROUND — LINCOLN GOLD PHASE 2 DELIVERS ANOTHER HIGH-GRADE BLOCK, CALIFORNIA
snippet: Haranga Resources (ASX: HAR) reported 32 metres at 10.4 g/t gold from 143 metres depth in its Phase 2 underground program at the Lincoln gold project in California on October 16, adding to a series of high-grade results that underpin the case for a resource update in Q1 2027. More than half the planned drill metres remain, with the campaign expected to conclude in early November — providing additional disclosure events before the resource estimate is compiled.

headline: FIRST MAJESTIC Q3 SILVER MISSES — SAN DIMAS LABOR DISPUTE CUTS 12 OPERATING DAYS, MINE OUTPUT FALLS 41% YoY
snippet: First Majestic Silver (NYSE: AG) produced 3.4 million silver ounces in Q3 2026, reaching only 72% of its revised annual guidance midpoint, after a labor dispute at the San Dimas mine disrupted operations for 12 days and cut that asset's silver output 41% year-over-year. La Encantada rose 68% to partially offset the gap; total gold output fell 17% YoY to 29,552 ounces. The result lands as spot silver recovers from a $55.64 post-CPI low toward $57.80, and highlights that mine-level labor disruptions — not just macro — are shaping the silver supply picture heading into Q4.

headline: ALKANE DRILLS 153M EPITHERMAL GOLD 1KM BELOW PEAK HILL PIT — DEEP PORPHYRY TARGET APPROVED FOR NOVEMBER DRILLING
snippet: Alkane Resources (ASX: ALK) reported on October 15 that deep hole PHD084 at Peak Hill, New South Wales intersected 153 metres of epithermal gold mineralisation at 0.11 g/t starting approximately 1 km below the existing Proprietary open pit, suggesting a concealed porphyry source at depth. A 6,600-metre follow-up program has been approved for November to test whether the zone holds economic grade below the current resource envelope — a potentially significant vertical extension of an operating gold mine.

headline: ONLY 22% OF XAU MEMBERS ABOVE 200-DAY MA — SILVER MINERS HIT HISTORIC OVERSOLD EXTREME AFTER CPI SHOCK
snippet: A October 15 analysis by precious metals commentator Brian Wilkes documents that just 22% of Philadelphia Gold and Silver Index members were trading above their 200-day moving averages after two consecutive sessions of CPI-driven selling pushed spot silver to $55.64 and the XAU down 4.64% on October 14. Wilkes argues the setup is reaching historical oversold extremes that have historically preceded sharp reversals, but stresses that confirmation requires gold to hold $4,100 — a level briefly violated before Friday's recovery — and that a single failed support test would invalidate the bull case.
